title: Standards and requirements for air filtration
summary: Classification and documented maintenance help prove compliance and protect users.
paragraphs: Air-filter classification systems (such as ISO and EN) make it easier to compare efficiency and pick the right product for an application. Critical zones often add internal and industry-specific requirements on top.
Documented filter changes, pressure readings and equipment IDs simplify audits and reduce the risk of running outside design conditions.
BasicAir can help navigate filter classes and select solutions that fit facility requirements in Latvia.
